people_social_roles.note: `இரவலர்`, army-bearing kings and ruler/patron roles are retained.

relationships.note: Supplicants and ruler-to-ruler tribute/conflict relations are explicit.

food_subsistence.note: `தொடுத்துணக் கிடப்பினும்` is retained only as source-explicit availability of something to eat; no unstated commodity is supplied.

weapons_warfare.note: Full armies and coercive victory over kings are retained as warfare evidence.

economy.note: Provision for supplicants and `திறை` taken from kings are explicit economic/patronage evidence.

polity_political_life.note: Kings, army and tribute are explicit polity evidence.

communities_social_groups.note: `இரவலர்` are retained as a source supplicant group.

values_ethical_concepts.note: The comparison of the land's two excellences—supporting supplicants and defeating kings—is retained as evaluative reasoning.
